title.zh: 中华人民共和国的成立与发展

clips.send: 1953–1956, Industrialisation begins. The First Five-Year Plan put heavy industry first: Anshan Steel, the first Jiefang truck from Changchun (1956), the first jet aircraft from Shenyang (1956), the Wuhan Yangtze River Bridge (1957), and the Sichuan–Tibet and Qinghai–Tibet highways (1954). In 1954 the first Constitution was adopted; by 1956 the socialist transformation was basically complete.

clips.send: 1997, 1999, Hong Kong and Macao return. Following Deng Xiaoping’s idea of “one country, two systems”, China resumed sovereignty over Hong Kong on 1 July 1997 and Macao on 20 December 1999. Taiwan is an inalienable part of China; cross-Strait exchanges keep growing.

clips.send: Shenzhou-5 and the Long March rockets. 2003. China’s first crewed spaceflight. October 2003: Shenzhou-5, launched by a Long March 2F rocket, carried Yang Liwei, China’s first astronaut, into space. China became the third country able to send people into space on its own. 2008: Shenzhou-7 — Zhai Zhigang made China’s first spacewalk. The Long March rocket family carries China’s satellites, spaceships and space-station modules.

clips.send: Summary. In seventy years New China stood up (1949), began to grow prosperous through reform and opening up (1978), and in the new era is becoming strong. Now explore the 3D hall of achievements!

clips.send: 1950–1953, Consolidating the new republic. In October 1950 the Chinese People’s Volunteers, led by Peng Dehuai, crossed the Yalu River; the armistice was signed in July 1953. Tibet was peacefully liberated in 1951, and land reform abolished the feudal land system by the end of 1952.
clips.text: 1950–1953 · Consolidating the new republic. In October 1950 the Chinese People’s Volunteers, led by Peng Dehuai, crossed the Yalu River; the armistice was signed in July 1953. Tibet was peacefully liberated in 1951, and land reform abolished the feudal land system by the end of 1952.

clips.send: 2003–2022, Science and technology soar. Shenzhou-5 carried Yang Liwei into space (2003); Chang’e reached the Moon (2007) and its far side (2019); high-speed rail linked Beijing and Tianjin (2008); BeiDou went global (2020); the Tiangong space station was completed (2022).

clips.send: 1956–1976, Construction in hard times. Despite setbacks, there were great achievements: the Daqing oil field (“Iron Man” Wang Jinxi), the first atomic bomb (1964), hydrogen bomb (1967) and satellite Dongfanghong-1 (1970), the Nanjing Yangtze River Bridge (1968) and Yuan Longping’s hybrid rice (1973).
clips.text: 1956–1976 · Construction in hard times. Despite setbacks, there were great achievements: the Daqing oil field (“Iron Man” Wang Jinxi), the first atomic bomb (1964), hydrogen bomb (1967) and satellite Dongfanghong-1 (1970), the Nanjing Yangtze River Bridge (1968) and Yuan Longping’s hybrid rice (1973).

clips.send: “Two bombs and one satellite”. 1964, 1967, 1970. Nuclear bombs, missiles and a man-made satellite. October 1964: China’s first atomic bomb was successfully tested. October 1966: China’s guided nuclear missile test succeeded. June 1967: China’s first hydrogen bomb was successfully tested. April 1970: China launched its first man-made Earth satellite, Dongfanghong-1 (“The East Is Red-1”). Scientists such as Deng Jiaxian and Qian Xuesen made outstanding contributions; their spirit is the “two bombs, one satellite” spirit.

clips.send: 1980, Special economic zones. Four special economic zones were set up: Shenzhen, Zhuhai, Shantou and Xiamen — “windows” for technology, management and knowledge. In 1988 Hainan became a province and the largest special economic zone.

clips.send: 1984–2001, All-round opening up. In 1984 14 coastal port cities were opened; in 1990 Shanghai Pudong was developed and opened; in 2001 China joined the WTO. A pattern formed: special economic zones, coastal open cities, coastal open economic regions, inland.
clips.text: 1984–2001 · All-round opening up. In 1984 14 coastal port cities were opened; in 1990 Shanghai Pudong was developed and opened; in 2001 China joined the WTO. A pattern formed: special economic zones → coastal open cities → coastal open economic regions → inland.

clips.send: 1 October 1949, The founding ceremony. In September the CPPCC adopted the Common Programme and chose Beijing as the capital, the five-star red flag and the “March of the Volunteers”. On 1 October Mao Zedong proclaimed the founding of the People’s Republic of China at Tian’anmen.

clips.send: 1978, A great turning point. The Third Plenary Session of the 11th Central Committee (December 1978) restored “emancipating the mind and seeking truth from facts”, shifted the focus to economic construction and launched reform and opening up. Farmers in Xiaogang Village, Anhui, began the household contract responsibility system.

clips.send: 1997年 · 1999年 · 香港、澳门回归。根据邓小平提出的“一国两制”构想，中国政府于1997年7月1日对香港、1999年12月20日对澳门恢复行使主权。台湾是中国领土不可分割的一部分，海峡两岸交往不断加强。

clips.send: 汕头。汕头是广东东部的港口城市，许多华侨的祖籍在这里。

clips.send: 1978年 · 伟大的历史转折。1978年12月中共十一届三中全会重新确立解放思想、实事求是的思想路线，把工作重点转移到经济建设上来，作出实行改革开放的决策。安徽凤阳小岗村农民率先实行家庭联产承包责任制。

clips.send: 1980年 · 经济特区。我国在深圳、珠海、汕头、厦门设立四个经济特区，它们成为对外开放的“窗口”。1988年海南建省，成为我国最大的经济特区。

clips.send: 1956—1976年 · 艰辛探索与建设成就。探索中虽有曲折，也取得了巨大成就：大庆油田（“铁人”王进喜）、第一颗原子弹（1964）、第一颗氢弹（1967）、“东方红一号”卫星（1970）、南京长江大桥（1968），以及袁隆平的杂交水稻（1973）。

clips.send: 1953—1956年 · 工业化起步。“一五”计划优先发展重工业：鞍山钢铁公司、长春第一汽车制造厂生产出第一辆国产汽车（1956）、沈阳飞机制造厂试制成功第一架喷气式飞机（1956）、武汉长江大桥建成（1957）、康藏（川藏）和青藏公路通车（1954）。1954年通过第一部《中华人民共和国宪法》；1956年底三大改造基本完成。

clips.send: 小结。七十多年来，新中国站起来（1949），通过改革开放富起来（1978），在新时代强起来。接下来去3D成就展厅看看吧！

clips.send: 1949年10月1日 · 开国大典。9月，中国人民政治协商会议通过起临时宪法作用的《共同纲领》，决定国都定于北平并改名北京，以五星红旗为国旗，以《义勇军进行曲》为代国歌。10月1日，毛泽东在天安门城楼宣告中华人民共和国中央人民政府成立。

clips.send: “神舟五号”与长征系列火箭。2003。中国首次载人航天飞行。2003年10月，长征二号F火箭将“神舟五号”载人飞船送入太空，杨利伟成为中国进入太空的第一人。。中国成为世界上第三个独立掌握载人航天技术的国家。。2008年，“神舟七号”航天员翟志刚实现中国人首次太空行走。。长征系列运载火箭承担了我国卫星、飞船和空间站舱段的发射任务。
